initial.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Route Shepherd conversation replies through its configured provider
initial.goal: Make fresh resident Shepherd conversation turns use the Shepherd's configured model provider instead of a hardcoded acknowledgement.
initial.required_outcome: A Shepherd turn invokes its configured provider and returns generated content in the existing reply envelope; provider failure is explicit and never becomes synthetic success.
authority_boundary: Issue #661 owns only Shepherd reply execution
Issue #640 supplies configured model-backed Shepherd state
operator_constraints: Never write tracked files on main
Do not restart or mutate the live Runtime
Do not widen into agent-to-agent initiation
initial.task_boundary: Replace the Shepherd synthetic acknowledgement with governed configured-provider execution and focused success/failure proof.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Fresh Shepherd turn invokes its configured provider exactly once
AC-2: Non-empty generated content is returned
AC-3: Recipient, schema, conversation, and work correlation remain correct
AC-4: Provider failure is explicit and cannot return the acknowledgement
AC-5: Existing non-Shepherd provider-backed behavior remains valid
AC-6: Focused tests, hygiene, and exact-head review pass
initial.plan_summary: Trace the Shepherd-only reply branch, route it through existing configured provider execution, add deterministic success and failure proof, then review and publish.

steps.action: Trace Shepherd conversation dispatch and the existing provider-backed resident-agent path.
Remove synthetic success and invoke the configured Shepherd provider through the governed boundary.
Add focused provider invocation, generated reply, correlation, and failure tests.
Run focused validation and independent exact-head review.

stop_conditions: Configured provider cannot be resolved without redesign

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove fresh Shepherd turns invoke the configured provider, return generated content with correct correlation, and expose provider failure without fallback.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Focused test names are finalized after tracing the existing execution surface.

initial.failure_policy: Fail explicitly when provider resolution or execution fails; never substitute a hardcoded acknowledgement.
review_prompts: Does every Shepherd reply use configured provider execution?
initial.review_scope: Resident Shepherd conversation reply execution and focused deterministic tests only.
